completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.

Nineteen precision-amended full triples were then reread, and the subsequently added Isaiah 33:1 to 50:9 full triple was read after its necessary 50:7-11 context. findings_resolved.resolution: Category preserves the distinction between ungodly people and their wealth in the chaff images.

target_units.text: At the completion of the words, Nebuchadnezzar, when he heard the judgment of the vision, kept the words in his heart.
After twelve months, the king was walking upon the city walls with all his glory and passing over its towers.
He spoke and said, “This is great Babylon, which I built, and it will be called the house of my kingship through the strength of my might, for the honor of my glory.”

At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

The angels will pursue you for seven years. You will neither be seen nor speak with any human being. They will feed you grass like an ox, and your pasture will be the earth’s greenery. Behold! In place of your glory they will bind you, and another will have your luxurious house and your kingdom.
By morning everything will be fulfilled upon you, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon; nothing of all this will fail.”

“I, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, was bound for seven years. They fed me grass like an ox, and I ate the earth’s greenery. After seven years I devoted my soul to supplication and pleaded concerning my sins before the Lord, the God of heaven; concerning my acts of ignorance I entreated the great God of gods.

My hair became like an eagle’s wings, and my nails like a lion’s. My flesh and my heart were changed; I walked naked with the wild animals of the earth. I saw a dream, and apprehensions seized me. After a time a deep sleep took hold of me, and drowsiness fell upon me.

At the completion of the seven years, the time of my release came. My sins and my acts of ignorance reached their full measure before the God of heaven. I entreated the great God of gods concerning my acts of ignorance, and an angel called to me from heaven, saying, ‘Nebuchadnezzar, serve the holy God of heaven and give glory to the Most High; the kingship of your nation is restored to you.’
At that time my kingdom was restored to me and my glory returned to me.

I give thanks to the Most High and praise Him who created heaven and earth, seas and rivers, and everything in them. I give thanks and praise, for He is God of gods, Lord of lords, and King of kings. He performs signs and wonders and changes seasons and times, taking kingdoms from kings and appointing others in their place.

target_verses.text: At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.

target_verses.text: The angels will pursue you for seven years. You will neither be seen nor speak with any human being. They will feed you grass like an ox, and your pasture will be the earth’s greenery. Behold! In place of your glory they will bind you, and another will have your luxurious house and your kingdom.

target_verses.text: By morning everything will be fulfilled upon you, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon; nothing of all this will fail.”

target_verses.text: “I, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, was bound for seven years. They fed me grass like an ox, and I ate the earth’s greenery. After seven years I devoted my soul to supplication and pleaded concerning my sins before the Lord, the God of heaven; concerning my acts of ignorance I entreated the great God of gods.

target_verses.text: My hair became like an eagle’s wings, and my nails like a lion’s. My flesh and my heart were changed; I walked naked with the wild animals of the earth. I saw a dream, and apprehensions seized me. After a time a deep sleep took hold of me, and drowsiness fell upon me.

target_verses.text: At the completion of the seven years, the time of my release came. My sins and my acts of ignorance reached their full measure before the God of heaven. I entreated the great God of gods concerning my acts of ignorance, and an angel called to me from heaven, saying, ‘Nebuchadnezzar, serve the holy God of heaven and give glory to the Most High; the kingship of your nation is restored to you.’

target_units.text: When evening came, a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph came, who himself had also become Jesus’ disciple.
He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate ordered it to be given.
Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.
He laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut in the rock. Rolling a great stone to the tomb’s entrance, he went away.

unresolved_candidates.reason: Matthew narrates rich Joseph placing Jesus's body in his tomb. The actual Isaiah verse speaks of the wicked in exchange for his burial and the rich in exchange for his death; it does not state that his grave is assigned with a rich man. That proposed grave-detail equivalence remains unretained, while the no-iniquity/no-deceit clause has a separately supported counterpart.
